title: Activating the "Minimize All" widget should close open Panel popups, as the "Peek at Desktop" one does
line: Clicking Minimize All Windows now also closes an open Kickoff or System Tray popup, including the tray's hidden icons view, like Peek at Desktop does.
explanation: Peek at Desktop goes through KWin's show-desktop mode, which activates the desktop, so popups that hide on focus loss close. Minimize All only asks the task manager to minimize each window and never moves focus, so an open Kickoff or System Tray popup stayed on screen over the empty desktop. libplasma's Corona gets a closeAppletPopups() call that collapses every applet popup that would close on focus loss (pinned ones stay open); the System Tray, which runs its own popup, now binds its hideOnWindowDeactivate to its pin setting and closes on the same request, and Minimize All calls it after minimizing.

commits.message:
Corona: add closeAppletPopups()

Minimize All Windows hides all windows without moving focus, so applet
popups that close on focus loss stayed open over the desktop. This adds
a Corona call that collapses those popups and keeps pinned ones open.

BUG: 481615

applets/systemtray: close the popup on Corona's closeAppletPopups()

The System Tray manages its own popup, so collapsing applets didn't
close its hidden items view. It now binds hideOnWindowDeactivate to its
pin setting and closes its popup when the shell asks, unless pinned.

BUG: 481615

applets/showdesktop: close applet popups when minimizing all windows

Minimize All only minimized windows and never moved focus, so an open
Kickoff or System Tray popup stayed on top of the desktop, unlike with
Peek at Desktop. It now asks the shell to close unpinned popups.

BUG: 481615

From 551fffa677e4e5989d91821a3c5d1c817d7f5b54 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>

Subject: [PATCH] applets/showdesktop: close applet popups when minimizing all
 windows

Minimize All only minimized windows and never moved focus, so an open
Kickoff or System Tray popup stayed on top of the desktop, unlike with
Peek at Desktop. It now asks the shell to close unpinned popups.

BUG: 481615
---
 applets/showdesktop/MinimizeAllController.qml | 2 ++
 1 file changed, 2 insertions(+)

diff --git a/applets/showdesktop/MinimizeAllController.qml b/applets/showdesktop/MinimizeAllController.qml
index 1e35f0c72c..51b566e7ac 100644
--- a/applets/showdesktop/MinimizeAllController.qml
+++ b/applets/showdesktop/MinimizeAllController.qml
@@ -9,6 +9,7 @@
 
 import QtQml
 
+import org.kde.plasma.plasmoid
 import org.kde.taskmanager as TaskManager
 
 Controller {
@@ -87,6 +88,7 @@ Controller {
             }
         }
         minimizedClients[activityDesktopId] = clients;
+        Plasmoid.containment.corona.closeAppletPopups();
         activeByActivityDesktop[activityDesktopId] = true;
         activeByActivityDesktopChanged()
     }
--

With the fix: same steps, Kickoff closes together with the windows.

With the fix: the hidden icons view closes too.

With the fix: the tray popup closes.

review.text: Good multi-repo architecture moving popup dismissal into libplasma's Corona::closeAppletPopups(), wiring System Tray to hideOnWindowDeactivate, and invoking it from MinimizeAllController. However, AppletQuickItem::itemForApplet connects appletPopupsCloseRequested to all non-containment applets including System Tray sub-applets (Containment::CustomEmbedded), which still have hideOnWindowDeactivate true even when the System Tray is pinned and will wrongly collapse an open sub-applet like Power & Battery. Also use CCBUG on the prerequisite libplasma and plasma-workspace commits so Bugzilla is not closed before plasma-desktop lands.
changes: In libplasma/src/plasmaquick/appletquickitem.cpp, skip connecting appletPopupsCloseRequested for applets whose containment has containmentType() == Plasma::Containment::CustomEmbedded (so the embedding containment, such as System Tray, owns popup dismissal and pin state for its sub-applets).

Verify the pinned System Tray regression case with a sub-applet (e.g. Power & Battery) open, ensuring both the tray popup and the sub-applet remain open and expanded after clicking Minimize All Windows.
Change BUG: 481615 to CCBUG: 481615 on the libplasma and plasma-workspace commits, keeping BUG: 481615 only on the plasma-desktop commit that completes the fix.

reviews.text: Right diagnosis: Peek goes through KWin's show-desktop mode, which moves focus, while Minimize All only minimizes through TasksModel. A small generic libplasma API (Corona::closeAppletPopups() and its signal, connected once per AppletQuickItem at creation) collapses unpinned popup applets, skips containments and in-place full representations, and the tray handles its own dialog through the same signal. That keeps the logic out of the showdesktop applet and matches Peek: pinned Kickoff and tray stay open. The before/after screenshots cover Kickoff, the tray's hidden view and a tray applet popup, and the regressions (restore, pinned popups, the tray shortcut, a desktop Notes widget) and autotests are reasonable; each of the three commits has BUG: 481615 and matches its diff. Nits only: the tray's new root hideOnWindowDeactivate binding is only read by its own Connections (checking the pin setting directly would do), and in MinimizeAllController the closeAppletPopups() call could go after the activeByActivityDesktop update so a failure there can't leave the toggle state stale.
